lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+3.0% average after noise correction), though the second test showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_screen changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for home and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to measured results.

candidates.title: Interactive waiting tips during pet generation
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout with a tip carousel to keep users engaged while generation completes.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to significant idle drop-off.

components.text: Discover desktop pet tricks and shortcuts while your pet is generated.

guard.reason: Redesign keeps the waiting screen job of showing pet generation in progress.

candidates.score_note: Home redesigns previously showed negative lift (-3.3%) and require new screen development.

candidates.title: Move sign-in step after home intro
candidates.change: Shift the sign-in screen to occur right after home intro so users experience their active pet before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in loses 24% of users before they get to see their adoption pet live.

guard.reason: home_intro must come after every existing screen, sign_in included

candidates.title: Spotlight path selection layout
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen into a spotlight layout to highlight pet adoption paths clearly.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users and has an extended mean duration of 514s.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Create Your Pet
choose_path.body: Pick from ready-made pet companions or upload photos to build a custom pet.

guard.reason: Redesign retains both adopting ready-made pets and creating a custom pet.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns generally lack strong positive historical evidence and require a new release.

candidates.title: Stage layout redesign for adoption certificate
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen with a stage layout and visual preview of the adopted pet.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate in onboarding, converting only 60.9% of users.

guard.reason: Redesign replaces certificate components with preview only, losing the required official stamp.

candidates.title: Photo upload guidance copy update
candidates.change: Update headline and body on upload photos screen with clear photo lighting and pose recommendations.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints about custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Use clear, well-lit photos facing forward for optimal 3D pet generation results.
upload_photos.hint: Avoid heavy shadows or blurry images.

guard.reason: Valid copy update providing photo guidelines without breaking rules.

candidates.score_note: Direct support mail feedback targeting the lowest-converting step (39.1% drop) via simple copy change.

candidates.title: Time estimate and ready notification on waiting screen
candidates.change: Enable time estimates and background ready notification toggles during pet generation waiting.
candidates.why: Users spend up to 201s median on waiting, causing confusion and drop-offs.

waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize; we will notify you as soon as your pet is ready.

guard.reason: Time estimate for a real generation wait is permitted under Rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Config-only waiting time notification tackling high median/mean idle duration.

candidates.title: Sign-in device sync hint
candidates.change: Add a hint on sign-in clarifying that signing in protects pets from being lost across logins.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your active pets and syncs them to your account.

guard.reason: Valid sign-in hint addition inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Directly backed by 8 support tickets and implemented via low-cost hint text.

candidates.title: Grid layout for pick friend screen
candidates.change: Change the pick friend screen layout to a structured grid view.
candidates.why: Adoption takes a median of 89s and drops 39.1% of users.

guard.reason: Valid grid layout change for pick friend screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high drop-off on adoption step (39.1%) with layout restructuring.

candidates.title: Desktop control instructions on home intro
candidates.change: Add explicit instructions to home intro body copy explaining how to interact with and hide the pet via system tray.
candidates.why: Support received several inquiries from users confused about controlling or hiding their pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Active on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click your pet to interact, or right-click its icon in the system tray to hide or adjust settings.
home_intro.hint: System tray icon allows hiding and toggling pet visibility anytime.

guard.reason: Valid copy update for home intro explaining desktop controls.

candidates.score_note: Low cost text update responding to explicit user support confusion.

candidates.title: Mascot badge on adoption certificate
candidates.change: Add a mascot celebration badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Improving completion motivation on adoption screen targets the lowest converting onboarding step (60.9%).

guard.reason: Adding a new mascot component to adoption certificate is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets the lowest converting onboarding step (60.9%) by adding completion incentive UI.

picked: Interactive waiting tips during pet generation
held_by_harm_budget: Desktop control instructions on home intro
